title: Combination Sum II
goal: Solve Combination Sum II: Sort candidates, choose each index at most once, and skip equal alternatives at the same recursion depth.
strategy: Sort candidates, choose each index at most once, and skip equal alternatives at the same recursion depth.
edgeCases: Equal values at different indices can be used together, but duplicate result combinations must not be emitted.
inputRules: Target must be a positive integer.
